name: text-garbled
about: An image-generated mockup of the game's HUD (codex image_gen or local Qwen-Image): is any UI text garbled, so the take needs a re-roll? Calibrated in D3 (docs/plans/DECISION-MODELS.md).
state: A mockup screenshot of a 3D game's HUD on a phone or desktop. Every piece of UI text should be real, correctly spelled English: button labels like ATTACK, DODGE, JUMP, VITALS, place names, quest titles and short notes.

garbled.instructions: Is any of the on-screen UI text misspelled, garbled, smeared into unreadable shapes, or made of nonsense letters?
